body:
Chief: M1'S PARTIAL LANDED at merge e4b80d0, pushed. THE BEAD STAYS OPEN - mass-weighted fidelity and expectation-over-anchors are still to come, and I am not closing a bead because the part that shipped went green.

Gate on the merged tree, unpiped, SBT_EXIT=0, zero errors: scalafmt both, compileAll all platforms, align 169/169 on all three, embedBench 52/52, lawsJVM 81/81, interviewJVM 76/76. Verified on landed main: compression and semanticFlowCoherence are MassRatio rather than Double, MassRatio is a final non-case class with private construction so it does not repeat the forge, and estimandVersion is a def reading from the code rather than a constructor field - derived, never caller-supplied, as required.

WHAT WAS ON MAIN UNTIL NOW, stated plainly because it is the clearest example of this defect class we have found: coherence emitted 1.0 - PERFECT - for a step with no source-to-source mass, and for an EMPTY FLOW. Compression emitted 0.0, which on that scale means MAXIMALLY FINE-GRAINED, the most specific recall possible, asserted about a unit we could not place at all. One flatters the participant, one penalises them, and both come from the same absence. If anyone still wonders why this class is sign-agnostic, that is the answer in two lines.

FOUR LANDINGS IN THIS STRETCH: the population reference shape, m1's projection stack, the scout's route-axis and abstention fix, and this. Main has gone from publishing five components as zero when absent, and a perfect score for an empty flow, to refusing or reporting support in every one of those places.

Three actors are on the next things: engineer on the embed-core sweep with authorization types re-ranked first, scout on the interview specificity split with MissingReason.Custom authorized, m1 on the remaining half of the redefinitions.
